universe.asof_eligibility: Listed and existing at selection cutoff, at least252 mainland exchange sessions since listing, benchmark/type verified by contemporaneous documents
universe.sorting: Within each eligible class: listing_date ascending, then zero-padded six-digit security_code ascending, then venue ascending
universe.selection_owner: 尼哥2 verifies exact codes, asof historical candidate list, listing dates, classification and evidence; coordinator binds selected four

period.warmup: 2024 primarily; include the minimum earlier2023 sessions if required to have253 genuine price observations before first252-return signal
period.calendar: Verified common mainland exchange trading calendar; session count derived from bound data, not hardcoded
period.across_years: One continuous cash/inventory/receivable ledger; no January restart
period.research_status: All already-viewed years exploratory; no blind-test claim

signal.basis: Own CNY secondary-market total return computed from raw ETF close prices plus verified cash distributions and unit-conversion events, all known by signal close
signal.daily_gross_factor: g[d]=(S[d]*C[d]+D_old_unit[d])/C[d-1]; S is new units per previous-day unit (default1), D is cash entitlement per previous-day unit (default0); normalize source units and action ordering explicitly
signal.window_return: product(g for the252 latest calendar return intervals ending at signal_date)-1
signal.cash_distribution_timing: Recognize in signal on official ex-distribution date, not payment date; only public terms available by that close; do not use a later revised vendor adjustment without provenance
signal.signal_reinvestment: Theoretical ex-date reinvestment embedded in gross-factor chain; actual account does not automatically reinvest before next rebalance
signal.no_double_adjustment: Do not apply distributions/splits again to a vendor total-return or adjusted-price series; raw-price-plus-events is canonical, adjusted series is independent diagnostic only
signal.missing: First node requires valid253-observation/252-factor history for all four. Later uncomputable asset signal targets cash for that class and is logged; never change lookback or fill from future observations
signal.no_fund_nav_fx_or_premium_signal: Official NAV/IOPV/FX are diagnostics only. No premium threshold, currency overlay or underlying-index feature; CNY ETF prices already include currency effects

strategy.decision_nodes: Close of evaluation session indices0,20,40,...; first signal is first evaluation day's close, not the preceding2024 close
strategy.trend_target: Each class independently: window_return>0 gives0.25 of signal-time totalNAV; window_return<=0 or later missing gives0; remainder is cash
strategy.static_target: 0.25 of signal-time totalNAV per selected ETF at the same decision nodes
strategy.end_mark: Mark at final close including legitimate receivables; no mandatory terminal liquidation or future-day trade

execution.adapter: Isolated ETF runner/fee and event adapter; stock engine and frozen stock rules remain unchanged
execution.order_formation: At decision close derive integer unit targets from target_weight*totalNAV/raw_close; floor buys to verified buy lot. Use source-verified residual/odd-lot sell rule; never erase residual units
execution.execution_day: Next mainland exchange session only; first possible fill is2025-01-03 if verified calendar confirms it. A last-day decision without an in-period next session is not executed
execution.price_assumption: Verified next-session actual ETF unadjusted open from the bound source, with fixed directional slippage, rounded to actual product tick: buys round upward, sells downward. Third-party fallback is labelled and not falsely described as official exchange data. This is a daily-bar simulation, not proven opening-auction fills.
execution.trade_order: Apply due events/availability first; eligible net sells before net buys; use deterministic class order CN_EQUITY,US_EQUITY,GOLD,CN_GOV_BOND within each side
execution.cash_and_quantity: Keep decision-close target quantities; opening gaps may cause cash-limited buys, never borrowing. If aggregate requested buys exceed cash including fees, scale requests proportionally, floor to lots, then charge each actual fill's fee; retain rounding cash rather than prioritize one asset to fill25-percent weights
execution.availability: Bind actual T+1/T+0 eligibility by product/date. No strategy relies on same-unit intraday round trips; sold cash reusable same day only under verified local brokerage/exchange convention, withdrawal and cross-border creation settlement are irrelevant
execution.liquidity_capacity: Each order capped at1percent of prior20 exchange sessions' mean traded ETF units, using information known at decision close; floor to lots. Record every capacity-induced partial fill; no future full-day volume used to choose order size
execution.no_fill_conditions: No valid open/zero trading activity/suspension/not-yet-available units; conservatively no BUY at opening upper limit, no SELL at opening lower limit when such limits apply. Tick-rounded simulated price outside valid daily range/limit is unfilled, not silently clipped
execution.unfilled_order_expiry: Cancel at end of that execution session; no within-stage retries or discretionary rebalancing; reevaluate only at next20-session node
execution.valuation: Raw closing price times owned units plus cash and declared distribution receivables; known suspension can carry last publicly available mark with a flag, never substitute official fundNAV for a missing tradable price

fees_and_tax.investor_scope: Simulated domestic individual secondary-market ETF investor; no direct overseas securities or professional primary-market participant

standard.commission_definition: Inclusive broker commission assumption max(5,notional*0.0003), rounded half-up toCNY cents; includes broker-passed exchange/settlement charges rather than adding them twice

stress.commission_definition: Double inclusive standard transaction commission and minimum; same rounding and fee base

fees_and_tax.assumption_disclosure: Commission/minimum/slippage are fixed public simulation assumptions, not an asserted user broker quote. Stress doubles transaction commissions and changes slippage5bp to10bp; does not invent exempt tax or change signal/windows
fees_and_tax.stamp_and_dividend_rule: Verify selected domestic ETF type/date against official secondary-market exemption and open-ended fund distribution policy. Do not apply A-share holding-period dividend tax. For verified covered fund distributions use announced investor cash per unit, no additional investor holding tax; product-specific exceptions require pre-run coordinator resolution
fees_and_tax.fund_embedded_expenses: Management/custody fees, underlying dividend withholding and fund trading costs already embodied in fund performance are not deducted again from the investor ledger
fees_and_tax.rounding: Cash balances calculated with auditable precision; transaction charge rounding half-up to cents, corporate payouts by product distribution terms

corporate_actions_and_settlement.distributions: Snapshot owned/eligible units at official registration cutoff; create receivable on official ex-date so price drop does not falsely eraseNAV; credit stated investor payout only on official payment date
corporate_actions_and_settlement.payment_intraday_convention: When exact intraday cash availability is not provided, recognize payment-date cash at end of day and make it spendable at next exchange open, not same-day opening. A stated non-trading payment date credits after that calendar date and is available at the next exchange open. Announced schedule is a disclosed simulation, not broker bank reconciliation
corporate_actions_and_settlement.fund_unit_conversion: Apply official conversion ratio, entitlement cutoff and new-unit tradability date; keep fractional/residual entitlements by official terms; do not treat it as a stock bonus/dividend-tax event
corporate_actions_and_settlement.no_fake_reinvestment: Account distribution cash is retained until scheduled target rebalance; signal and account action logic are deliberately distinct
corporate_actions_and_settlement.unresolved: Unknown payout scale, registration, ex-date, payment or unit-conversion availability blocks the affected event/account until explicit source resolution; never use2099 placeholder or delete cash claims

Common calendar and raw open/close/traded-unit data with listing/trading status; no untradable index substitutes
First-node253-close/252-return histories and event-normalized signal validated without future adjustment
Product/date lot, tick, availability, price-limit, secondary-market tax and distribution handling verified
Ledger includes real per-ETF units, cash, entitlement/receivable/payment and conversion events; no NAV splice or sleeve transfer
Fund-specific adapter smoke checks and independent cash/NAV/cost reconciliation pass before four-account economic run

input_and_execution_gates.missing_definition: Number of20-session nodes with at least one uncomputable252-factor signal divided by all scheduled nodes; first node failure is immediately blocking
input_and_execution_gates.nav_quality_diagnostics: QDII historical officialNAV/publish-time/valuation-day, premium notices and underlying calendar/FX may be incomplete; save gap and limit attribution, but do not block valid actual-CNY-price account simulation solely for missingNAV. No unverified premium timing rule
input_and_execution_gates.data_reuse: Reuse available matching inputs; acquire only verified four-ETF gaps under coordinator download budget; no market-wide duplicate download
input_and_execution_gates.halt_data_vs_halt_performance: Data/engineering failure invalidates economic conclusions; poor valid performance is retained and stops this fixed research hypothesis

evaluation.primary: After-cost zero-cash Sharpe=sqrt(252)*mean(daily_NAV_returns)/sample_std(ddof1); full common interval, first cash day included
evaluation.zero_volatility: Sharpe undefined, not positive infinity; cannot pass economic gate
evaluation.daily_return: NAV[t]/NAV[t-1]-1; initial priorNAV=initial capital; NAV includes legitimate outstanding receivables and no external contributions
evaluation.interpretation: Fixed decision preference, not proof of statistical significance or investment suitability. Only tests this own-return filter, not all cross-asset strategies
evaluation.uncertainty: Report paired Sharpe differences with20-session moving-block bootstrap,2000 repetitions,seed20261009; no tuning from intervals and no blind-test claim
secondary: Price-versus-NAV diagnostics with publication lag if available
evaluation.E00_reference: Only reuse accepted same-start continuous E00 if date, capital and first-signal/fill convention match; otherwise explicitly descriptive due to timing differences. No fifth ETF budget account or stitched2025/2026NAV
evaluation.fail_stop: Failed gate: retain all four valid results and stop this filter; no lookback, rebalance frequency, ETF replacement or start-date search. Any combination/phase selector is a separately authorized experiment
evaluation.no_old_stock_economic_gates: Do not reinstate per-year outperformance or prior stock drawdown thresholds; disclose risks alongside primary Sharpe
